# New podcast episode after a long time

For those who don’t know, I have a podcast that I don’t publicise called *50 Things That Define Zambia*.

Anyway, I just published a new episode after a really long break. I’m proud of this one because I put a lot of effort into it. Most of my episodes are short, running just under 10 minutes, but this one goes beyond the 10-minute mark. In fact, I’d go so far as to say it’s the longest episode I’ve ever made.

You can listen to it here:
